title: Value of refresh_token in a Zendesk OAuth token request or response
summary: A synthetic value of the refresh_token member in a JSON refresh request body, shown as a curl -d argument and a pretty-printed body, and of the refresh_token member in a token response excerpt.
rationale: Zendesk documents the refresh token as the refresh_token member of the JSON body of a refresh request to the OAuth token endpoint and of the JSON token response. The pages state no prefix, alphabet or width and the tutorial values are not a format, so the value is flagged because of the member it sits in, not because of its shape. The extent is the string value only: the member name, the colon and the quotes are outside it. The client identifier, the client secret placeholder, the expires_in and refresh_token_expires_in numbers are not values of this credential, and the access token of the same response is a different credential that these fixtures leave out.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Flagged under project policy: the string value of an exact refresh_token member of a token request or response is treated as a credential whatever its shape and covered whole. Zendesk documents the refresh_token member of the JSON request and response of the token endpoint (carrier existence only); the value admission, extent and generic attribution are the project's decisions. No prefix, width or alphabet is claimed.

sources.supports: Zendesk will respond with an access token and a refresh token. (the example response JSON has the members access_token, expires_in, refresh_token, token_type, scope and refresh_token_expires_in)
sources.locator: Exchanging the authorization code for tokens

sources.supports: use your refresh token to request a new access token with the Create Token for Grant Type endpoint: curl https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/oauth/tokens -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{ "grant_type": "refresh_token", "refresh_token": "{YOUR_REFRESH_TOKEN}", "client_id": "{YOUR_CLIENT_ID}", "client_secret": "{YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET}" }'

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
